Each dot is a seat in the Congress that takes office in February 2027. Parties run from left to right by the score political scientists give them on a 0–10 ideology scale. Hover over or tap a seat to see who holds it, and click to pin the member card. Seats can be coloured by ideology, gender or race, and filtered by state or by a name or party search.

The page itself is in Portuguese. [Open it full screen](/static/interactive/congresso-2027/) for more room, or on a phone.

```{=html}
<iframe id="congresso-2027" class="interactive-embed"
        src="/static/interactive/congresso-2027/"
        title="Interactive hemicycle of the Brazilian Congress elected in 2026"
        loading="lazy" scrolling="no"></iframe>

<style>
.interactive-embed {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 900px;
  border: 0;
}
</style>

<script>
// The embedded page is served from this site, so the parent can read its
// height directly and grow the iframe to fit, avoiding a nested scrollbar.
(function () {
  const frame = document.getElementById('congresso-2027');
  frame.addEventListener('load', () => {
    const win = frame.contentWindow;
    const doc = frame.contentDocument;
    if (!doc) return;
    const fit = () => {
      frame.style.height = doc.body.scrollHeight + 'px';
    };
    fit();
    new win.ResizeObserver(fit).observe(doc.body);
  });
})();
</script>
```

## Data

- Deputies and senators elected in 2026 come from the TSE candidate file. Votes are valid nominal votes.
- The Senate also keeps the 27 senators elected in 2022, whose terms run to 2031. Their parties come from the Senate open-data API.
- Ideology scores are the 2022 weighted means from Bolognesi, Ribeiro, Codato and Silva ([*Opinião Pública*, 2025](https://periodicos.sbu.unicamp.br/ojs/index.php/op/article/view/8682072)). PRD takes the mean of PTB and Patriota; Missão takes Novo's score.
